verdict.rationale: Paystack is a payments platform, so hosted invoicing with reminders is a fair axis. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions invoices, hosted invoice pages, or automatic payment reminders. The only related material covers generic one-time and recurring payment collection and a reporting dashboard, which are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can send hosted invoices with online payment and automatic reminders
